bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Frontend sends GET, backend only had POST handler

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause was HTTP method mismatch. Frontend components (GlobalHeader.js line 55, CommandPalette.js line 73, SearchResultsPage.js line 77) all call GET /api/search?q={query}&limit={limit}. Backend only had POST /api/search handler. Fix: Added GET handler at lines 69-84 in search_presence.py that accepts query params (q, limit, type) and calls the same SearchEngine.search_all() method.
